gloss: to smoke (food); to fumigate; to smolder

definitions.explanation: to preserve or flavor food by exposing it to smoke
to fill a space with smoke, often to drive out insects or pests

examples.japanese: {チーズ|ちーず}を{燻|いぶ}して{風味|ふうみ}を{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To smoke cheese to add flavor.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}のチップで{燻|いぶ}した{肉|にく}。
examples.english: Meat smoked with cherry wood chips.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}の{巣|す}を{煙|けむり}で{燻|いぶ}す。
{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}で{部屋|へや}を{燻|いぶ}す。
examples.english: To fumigate the room with mosquito coil.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
Intransitive pair: {燻|いぶ}る (to smolder)

SMOKED FOODS:
- {燻製|くんせい} (smoked product)
- スモークサーモン (smoked salmon)
- {燻|いぶ}し{卵|たまご} (smoked egg)
- {燻|いぶ}し{チーズ|ちーず} (smoked cheese)

SMOKING MATERIALS:
- {桜|さくら}のチップ (cherry wood chips)
- {楢|なら}のチップ (oak chips)
- {燻|いぶ}し{液|えき} (liquid smoke)

IDIOM:
{燻|いぶ}り{出|だ}す (to smoke out, to flush out) - also used figuratively

RELATED:
- {燻製|くんせい} (smoked food)
- {燻|いぶ}る (to smolder - intransitive)
- {煙|けむり}{燻|いぶ}し (fumigation, smoking)
